brief:
Civil society organizations in Gaza warned Sunday that the health system faces imminent total shutdown amid ongoing blockade and restrictions on medical and operational supplies entering the territory, Shehab Wire reported. The organizations cited deteriorating capacity as supplies dwindle under the siege conditions.

The warning comes as healthcare facilities across Gaza struggle to maintain basic operations. Restrictions on medical imports have forced hospitals and clinics to reduce services and ration essential equipment and medicines.

title: Gaza civil groups warn health system nears complete collapse
